resolvedFindings.finding: Filtering pg_stat_activity by backend_type can omit other-role sessions whose security-restricted fields are NULL, incorrectly permitting a shared-service stop.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The corrected query returns all other processes. A conservative classifier counts public database/user identities and endpoints; unknown hidden rows reject proof of zero clients. Three focused mocks were added to the existing 32 checks.

nonBlockingFindings.finding: Stop-QuickDemo prints postgresql=stopped even when StopOwned successfully preserves an unowned or busy service.
nonBlockingFindings.recommendation: Describe the lease/client-dependent outcome or propagate the actual result. Do not claim every successful wrapper call stopped PostgreSQL.

nonBlockingFindings.finding: Cloudflared identity checks PID, executable and command but does not store/check creation time; native runtime and PostgreSQL lease do check it.
nonBlockingFindings.recommendation: Before claiming complete tunnel PID-reuse protection, check creation time with a focused mock or retain this explicit limitation.
